name: What is the process for restoring a fence's stability?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for restoring a fence's stability?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically begins with an inspection to assess the damage and identify the cause of instability. This is followed by a proposal outlining the repair methods, which might include replacing damaged posts, adding concrete to reinforce existing posts, repairing or replacing fence panels, and strengthening gates. Once approved, our team carries out the work, aiming for minimal disruption to your property.
acceptedAnswer.description: The restoration process involves inspection, proposal of repairs (like post replacement or reinforcement), and execution of work to restore fence stability.
